description:
[Trading Data API] Single Kalshi market depth: orderbook (yes/no levels) + recent trades for a specific ticker. — Single Kalshi market depth: orderbook (yes/no levels) + recent trades for a specific ticker.

**Example:** `/v1/kalshi-market?ticker=KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99`

depth.description: Optional. Orderbook depth per side (default 10, max 100).

ticker.description: Required. A Kalshi market ticker (e.g. KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99).

trades.description: Optional. Recent trades to return (default 20, max 100).

name: kalshi_market
